content:
We need to find a template that when applied to the given molecule (target) reproduces the reaction: deprotection of TBS protecting group from an alcohol. The forward reaction: alcohol + TBDMSCl -> TBS-protected alcohol (O-Si). The retrosynthetic step: break O-Si bond, forming free alcohol (aliphatic hydroxyl) and TBS group (maybe as TBDMSCl? but they say functional group formed: aliphatic hydroxyls, and t-butyldimethylsilyl gone). So we need a template that breaks O-Si bond.

We have to return mapped_rxn associated with the template that when applied to the molecule reproduces the reaction. So we need to search template catalog for criteria: bonds_broken includes O-Si? The bond type maybe "6-6"? Not sure. We can search with functional_groups_broken maybe "t-butyldimethylsilyl"? Not in list. Might be easier: use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with bonds_broken specifying "6-6"? But O-Si is Si-O bond, atomic numbers 14 (Si) and 8 (O). Not sure representation.

Maybe we can just try to apply known template ID? Not known.

Alternative: Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with functional_groups_broken maybe "silyl_ether"? Not sure.

We could try to detect protecting groups in molecule to see if TBS present. Use detect_protection_groups.
